run_to_commit_identity.source_digest_rule: sha256 over name+bytes of src/trading_bot/research/edge01/*.py, scripts/edge01_run.py and scripts/edge01_verify.py, with CRLF folded to LF
run_to_commit_identity.how_to_check: Recompute the digest over the blobs of 4d7a67e with CRLF folded to LF; it equals the digest RUN_REPORT.json recorded at measurement, so the published numbers belong to the published code. The digest is recomputed the same way by trading_bot.research.edge01.campaign._git_state and is published with its rule in RUN_REPORT.json#git.
run_to_commit_identity.note: The measured run happened while HEAD was a76297e and the tree was dirty (the last artefacts and the documentation commits were still uncommitted), so HEAD alone would not identify the code behind the artefacts; the recorded source digest does. With the CRLF folding introduced by DEF-EDGE01-09 that digest is the same for the working tree, the stored blobs and a clean checkout; before the fix the same commit produced three different digests here (c832d958 / a81cb296 / 313b140b).
